faq_heading: Woodwards real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Woodwards is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 41 homes sold there: 22 houses and 18 townhomes. 22 houses sold in Woodwards with a median price of $1,772,500 (the middle half sold between $1,537,500 and $2,223,750), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 5% sold above list.
Woodwards home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

22 houses sold in Woodwards with a median price of $1,772,500 (the middle half sold between $1,537,500 and $2,223,750), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $654 per square foot, a median year built of 1981 and a median lot of 6,834 square feet. 18 townhomes sold in Woodwards with a median price of $1,213,900 (the middle half sold between $961,250 and $1,415,500), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 96.3% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $668 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median strata fee of $515 a month.

items.t: Caution: City sources use "Woodward" for places that may not be this sub-area. Woodwards Slough is a greenbelt at 9400 Dyke Road between the south end of Garden City Road and No. 4 Road. Woodward Neighbourhood School Park (10300 Seacote Road) is in Shellmont, beside Daniel Woodward Elementary. Neither establishes the MLS boundary.
The BC school directory lists Jessie Wowk Elementary at 5380 Woodwards Rd.
Zoning for a specific lot: check the City zoning map; Zoning Bylaw 8500 lists RS1/RS2 single detached and RSM small-scale multi-unit zones.

blocks.text: Woodwards: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Woodwards Slough: about 60 acres, natural area, trails, off-leash dog area, limited amenities, gated vehicle access, on the South Dyke Trail.
Woodward Neighbourhood School Park: ball diamonds, fields, track, playgrounds, community garden, trails.

blocks.text: Woodwards: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: Richmond averages about 1 m above sea level with river, ocean and rainfall flood risk.
The City plans to raise dikes from 3.5 m to 4.7 m and designs for a 1-in-500-year flood.
Bylaw 8204 sets flood construction levels (Schedule B figures were not reviewed) and a 7.5 m setback from a standard dike right of way.
The City says pockets of liquefaction are possible in a major earthquake; the BC Building Code requires designers to account for soil amplification and liquefaction.

faq.q: What did homes in Woodwards sell for?
faq.a: 22 houses sold in Woodwards between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,772,500.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Woodwards?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.0% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Woodwards sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 22 houses that sold in Woodwards went for between $1,537,500 and $2,223,750, around a median of $1,772,500.

faq.q: Do houses in Woodwards sell above asking price?
faq.a: 5% of the 22 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.0% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Woodwards?
faq.a: The median year built was 1981 for the 22 houses sold in Woodwards.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Woodwards usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Woodwards had 4 bedrooms, from the 22 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
